title: Credit Administration Standard: Prior Parcel Releases and the Homesite Release Premium — Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
**Standard.** On a farmstead split of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage, a release-history addition is added to the release premium percentage of the homesite. It follows the parcels already released from the loan in the last 60 months: one release adds 5.0 points; two or more add 10.0 points; none adds nothing.

**What the records show.** The parcel release records on the loan's parcel history — a release on sale, on condemnation, as a farmstead split or on payoff — dated in the last 60 months.

| Parcels released from the loan in the last 60 months | Addition |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| one | 5.0 points |
| two or more | 10.0 points |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A pasture parcel sold and released 22 months ago, nothing else: 5.0 points.
- A parcel released on condemnation 40 months ago and another sold 59 months ago: 10.0 points.
- A single parcel released 61 months ago: outside the window, so nothing.
